item.title: STEVENAGE VS BARNSLEY REARRANGED
item.description: We can confirm that we will now travel to the Stevenage FC Stadium on Tuesday 21 April, 7:45pm kick-off. Tickets for the fixture on 10 February, postponed due to a waterlogged pitch, remain vaild for this new date. If you are unable to make the new date, refunds are available from the Box Office until 10am on Tuesday 21 April. Please bring the valid ticket along with you. Thank you for your fantastic support.

item.title: HOURIHANE NAMES REDS SIDE TO FACE POSH
item.description: Upcoming FixturesBarnsley Vs. Wycombe Wanderers - Sat, Mar 3rd 2026, 15:00The Reds make three changes from Saturday's 3-3 draw with AFC Wimbledon to face Peterborough United in Sky Bet League One this evening. Eoghan O'Connell comes into the starting eleven, alongside Adam Phillips. Georgie Gent makes his first start for the Reds' senior side since last facing Posh in Emirates FA Cup second round action.
